question: Among all borderless cards that are available in both 'arena' and 'mtgo', what percentage are not banned in any format?

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities L2
    WHERE L2.XCL_086 = T1.XCL_072
      AND L2.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.XCL_001)
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE T1.XCL_005 = 'borderless'
  AND T1.XCL_004 LIKE '%arena%'
  AND T1.XCL_004 LIKE '%mtgo%'

        SELECT 1 
        FROM legalities L2 
        WHERE L2.XCL_086 = T1.XCL_072

FROM cards AS T1
